conclusion.statement: The original source proves repeated full-state validation and unchanged durability boundaries. No proposed new cache integration has both a demonstrated equivalence qualification and measured benefit on the failing original Legacy call.

observation_input.provenance: Parent and current_runtime_review handoff; this static review did not fetch/re-read terminal logs or ZIPs.
observation_input.classification: Entire receive_public_page_from call-expression, not an activation/root substage measurement

path_findings: Node::open selects Legacy. Final complete page admits the final packet, then calls activation in the same original operation and absolute deadline; the final-page counter does not locate failure within this call.

Normal successful uninterrupted final activation from still-active genesis builds a staging copy and the whole attach journal, validates the full steps sequence once at resume entry, then commits each step individually.

Each attach performs original delta before-value comparison/write, cursor update/check, fresh complete staging SQL State/root, then wrapper fresh active SQL State/root, namespace/metadata/ancestry checks and original checkpoints before COMMIT.

The active State remains genesis until final publication. The final independent target root and publication transaction checks are additional; this is source topology, not an observed completed attach count.
The database uses WAL and synchronous=FULL. A mathematical cache cannot remove per-step durable commits, metadata/fs checks or current SQL reads under the requested equivalence boundary.
Activation and SQL-commit observations in these methods are AuthenticatedV1-only. Authenticated report costs are not measurements of this Legacy selector.
existing_cache_findings: FullRootArithmetic already exists as one per-Node mutex-wrapped 2 MiB retained-material pool; root() is private. It is currently supplied to commitment/snapshot/execution paths, not Legacy persisted-State checks.

The arithmetic pool has one previous material entry. Calling it for both staging and genesis replaces the material alternately. Some common partitions may still hit; continuous adjacent-staging reuse or benefit is not guaranteed.

Every fresh State retains full grammar/count checks; exact strings compare the complete current key/value before hash reuse; other values use current canonical bytes and original hash domains; all current leaves undergo collision checking and partition reuse requires entire tuple-slice equality.

Snapshot invalidation clears active and historical snapshots, not FullRootArithmetic. Pure current-input mathematics may outlive a rollback without becoming an installation or authorization capability; it cannot return cached State or bypass SQL checks.

Historical commitment cache already has 8 entries / 2 MiB payload / 16 MiB retained software charge and checks complete current State on each use; per-call snapshot workspace limit remains 512 MiB. These are separate retained/software bounds, not process RSS.
equivalence_constraints: Preserve fresh pq_accounts_v2::validate_state(state,cfg) before growth-profile dispatch; only the original ordinary-root branch may substitute equivalent pure arithmetic. A naked FullRootArithmetic root is not Settings::state_root.
Keep fresh record, continuity validation and its error classification, the original root errors, then fresh expected-root comparison in exactly the current order.
Do not replace Settings::state_root with checked_commitment/checked_snapshot: those have snapshot/limit/workspace/error-mapping/observation behavior and do not provide the same profile-aware entry.

Keep every original SQL row read, canonical current BLOB check, all keys/values (including old nonces/liabilities), delta before-value checks, callbacks, namespace/active-generation checks, durable cursor and per-step commit/crash boundaries.
Do not add transaction/scope guards merely for pure math reuse or change legitimate callback/error precedence; the cache mutex is limited to pure computation and falls back on contention/poison.

Reuse the existing retained pool without silently adding another 2 MiB pool; retained accounting does not establish transient peak/RSS equivalence. New integration still requires actual qualification.

candidate_boundary.all_persisted_checks: Mathematically plausible only behind the full profile-aware validation boundary; susceptible to staging/genesis material alternation.
candidate_boundary.active_tail_only: A narrower unimplemented possibility could avoid that particular alternation by leaving staging on the original root and applying pure math only at active-tail calculation. No claim that other consumers cannot evict, that this is measured hot, or that it repairs the deadline.
